scope: vasp_new complete single points only; no old DFT pooling
threshold_note: Common geometric reference, not DFT zero stress.
energy: VASP electronic free energy TOTEN; no fitted shift
virial: VASP compression-positive stress_kbar * cell_volume /1602.1766208; total eV
split_rule: low 0.3%-wide blocks: 2,7 holdout; 4,9 validation; others train; high 0.6%-wide blocks: 2,7,12 validation; others train; >=12 held out. No labels used.
guard_rule: Training points <0.04 percentage points from heldout/validation or >=11.94% are unused.
source_status: Unmatched source origins remain unresolved; their genuine DFT labels are retained with explicit provenance.
